svg.title: coderprint: 411k lines of code in use, of 500k written, all time
svg.desc: 410,660 lines of code in use (255,932 in production, 154,728 in tests), of 499,619 written (all time, charted since 09MAR2026): 1,501 commits across all branches, 36 active days, a longest streak of 21 days, a current streak of 21 days, and 4 languages written. They came in 3 bursts of 377, 35k and 465k lines of code. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 71%, TypeScript 12%, Python 9%, JavaScript 7%, other languages under 1%.
svg.metadata: Drawn by coderprint (https://github.com/WikdSolvemProbler/coderprint): its code, design and wordmark are Peter Shiller's, licensed as LICENSE.md, design/LICENSE.md and NOTICE.md there say. What the card reports is its owner's.
